headline: Man molests 4-yr-old girl
author: TNN
description: A four-year-old girl was molested by a 45-year-old rickshaw-puller late on Monday night.
body_text: NEW DELHI: A four-year-old girl was molested by a 45-year-old rickshaw-puller late on Monday night. The incident was reported from Ambedkar Nagar in northwest Delhi around 11pm. â€œThe accused, identified as Nandlal, offered the victim toffees and took her to a secluded spot where he tried to sexually assault her. She raised an alarm following which locals rushed to her aid and the accused fled the spot. We took the victim to BJRM hospital where a medical report says rape did not take place.
